definition: כִּלָּיוֺן noun masculine 1. failing, pining ; 2. annihilation (on formation compare Lag BN 200 ); — 1. construct כִּלְיוֺן עֵינַיִם Deut 28:65 failing of eyes (in longing, compare foregoing, and see Dr ). 2. כִּלָּיוֺן חָרוּץ Isa 10:22 annihilation, strictly decided .

כִּלָּיוֺן noun masculine

1. failing, pining;
